comment: Pinned inputs for `npm run books`. Each URL names a fixed commit; sha256 is checked after download and the build stops on a mismatch. 'retrieved' is the date the hash was first recorded. Role 'text' feeds the shipped books; 'crosscheck' is compared against the parsed stat blocks and spells but never shipped; 'reference' is the official PDF, used only for the optional fidelity check and never shipped or committed.
